rubric: A one-line copy change in one module: blast radius one module (0), a revert restores everything (0), no user or secret data (0). Risk is scored before the plan, from the record and the code map alone; complexity is how hard the change is to get right.

criteria.complexity: A few lines in one place

reading.why: One string in one module, a revert restores it, no data: the lowest level on all three scores, and a few lines in one place is S.

ruledOut.question: complexity
ruledOut.label: M
ruledOut.why: A feature in one module is more than a one-line copy fix.

ruledOut.question: complexity
ruledOut.label: L
ruledOut.why: Nothing here spans several modules or needs a new mechanism.

ruledOut.question: complexity
ruledOut.label: XL
ruledOut.why: A redesign or a staged rollout is far beyond a typo.
